source.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving

readset.full_text: All 19 PDF pages: cover, abstract, Sections 1-9, references 1-60 and Appendices A-C
retained_scope: Sections 6.3-6.5 simulation, calibration and label limits
Section 6.1 and Appendix B Table 3: Low experiments with unequal total per-phase PP
Section 7 and Appendices A-C applicability limits
readset.exclusions: No code/artifact repository, slides/video or other paper edition was acquired. Raw source assets remain private and are not bundled.

claim_map.claim: Independent phase configuration search assumes negligible cross-node KV transfer
Weak-cross-node-bandwidth planning shares an outer corresponding-layer grouping and jointly enumerates general per-phase intra-node parallelism configurations under combined GPU capacity
Low end-to-end experiments report unequal total per-phase PP: OPT-66B prefill TP=4/PP=1 and decoding TP=2/PP=2
claim_map.interpretation_limit: Shared outer grouping does not impose equal total PP or TP-only inner search; helper internals and concrete placement reconstruction remain unqualified here

claim_map.claim: Per-GPU goodput uses maximum request rate at joint TTFT/request-average-TPOT attainment divided by provisioned GPUs
High/vLLM++ ablation is simulated; printed calibration attainment differs by at most 1.8 percentage points
Duplicate weights and KV/source-buffer costs, throughput/resource-scarce counter-signals, preemption and fault-tolerance limitations

source_conflicts: Section 6.5 opening sentence swaps the Algorithm 1/2 High/Low labels; explicit algorithm titles and Section 6.4 identify Algorithm 1 as High and Algorithm 2 as Low.
The Table 2 less-than-2% phrase does not distinguish relative percentage error from absolute attainment difference. The retained arithmetic is an absolute 1.8-percentage-point maximum.
